notes: προσερχομένους heads on draw, on the analogy of ἐξέρχεται → cometh forth in rule 104; near spells the προσ- prefix. This differs from 7:19's ἐγγίζομεν → draw nigh on nigh because the roots differ, not because the frames do.
The supplied seeing rides on the participle ζῶν, a participle being a token that carries subordination under rule 86.
